title: Feathery Elytra
description: This Mod adds new elytra-based items to bring back the adventure of minecraft!
body: **Feathery Elytra** is a lightweight Fabric mod designed for Minecraft 1.21.11 It introduces a brand-new custom armor piece: the Feathery Elytra. This specialized item functions identically to the vanilla Elytra, granting players the ability to glide and soar through the skies smoothly.
